switch_rename_anomaly: The `switch` command reported {ok:false, error:'atomic rename failed', renamed_old:true, renamed_new:false} — but the second rename HAD taken effect: the new tree was live and serving the new API contract immediately afterwards, and the script's own revert was correctly skipped because it only reverts when laravel-admin is missing. rename() returned false while succeeding on this host. Consequence: switch aborted before its step 4/5, so the cache rebuild, the release status merge and CURRENT_RELEASE.json never ran. A one-off CLI script (_finish_switch.php) completed exactly those — config:clear, view:clear, config:cache, route:cache, view:cache (all exit 0), status.json 'switch' entry, and CURRENT_RELEASE.json pointing at _previous-20260917-111202 — then self-deleted. smoke-test-live passed afterwards (/login 200, /forgot-password 200, /admin 302, app_debug false, zero new log bytes). If this recurs: do NOT re-run switch blindly — first check whether the live tree is already the new release (the API contract is the fastest tell), because a second switch would rotate a healthy release out.
switch_gate_note: release-manager.php `switch` requires stage/build/contract_check/smoke_test_isolated but NOT migrate_apply, even when migrate-check reported pending migrations. Always read migrate-check and run migrate-apply before scheduling switch; never pre-schedule switch on a release that carries migrations.
upload_url_note: Generate the TUS upload URL for provatferi.org and point HOSTINGER_UPLOAD_URL at .../api/tus/public_html/admin. A URL whose root is public_html alone stages the release into the MAIN site's web root instead. The file-browser session behind a generated URL can expire well before its token's exp (a 2h-old one returned 403 on 2026-09-14) — regenerate if an upload is refused. A TUS upload can also return 204 with the right Upload-Offset and still not persist the file (observed 2026-09-17 with _diag.php); confirm a one-off script exists via the file listing before relying on it, since a missing file and the CLI guard both answer 404 over HTTP.
cron_invocation_note: Invoke as `/usr/bin/php /home/u951246149/domains/provatferi.org/laravel-admin-releases/_tooling/release-manager.php <cmd> <releaseId> 2>&1`, one command per cron. The `cd <tooling> && php release-manager.php ...` form produced no output and did not run on this host. A cron command containing a quoted `php -r` one-liner was rejected by the hosting API (empty uid returned) — upload a small script and invoke it by absolute path instead.
maintenance_script_note: Any one-off PHP script uploaded to public_html/admin that bootstraps Laravel from absolute paths WILL execute when requested over HTTP, not only via cron. Guard such scripts with `if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli') { http_response_code(404); exit; }` before uploading, and have them @unlink(__FILE__) when done. Delete the one-shot cron promptly: a second firing after the script self-deletes logs 'Could not open input file', which is expected, not a failure.
